homeSections.step1Desc: Search for free health camps near your location by category or date.
homeSections.step2Desc: Check services offered, timings, venue address, and available slots.
homeSections.step3Desc: Fill a quick form with your basic details to reserve your slot.
homeSections.step4Desc: Show your Registration Confirmation slip at the venue and receive free care.
homeSections.benefit1: Easy access to free health camp information
homeSections.benefit2: Increased healthcare awareness in local communities
homeSections.benefit3: Simple and quick online slot registration

aboutPage.title: About Community Health Camp Portal
aboutPage.content: The Community Health Camp Portal is a community-focused platform designed to improve awareness of free health camps organized by hospitals, NGOs, government organizations, and local groups.
aboutPage.disclaimer: This portal provides health camp information and registration facilities. It does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment.
